readerJob: Claude Opus 5.5 changed prices and usage limits. Which change applies to my subscription, and which applies only to API use? Separate developer token billing from subscription usage limits and understand why the announcement does not prove model-selector access for every individual plan.

paragraphs.exact: Claude API prices are separate from subscription usage limits

paragraphs.text: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5.5 on September 22.

For developers paying Anthropic directly for API use — a software connection to a model — input costs $4 and output $20 per million tokens. Those are usage charges based on text processed, not monthly Claude subscription prices.
